hed: Mild Monday on the Lake: Perfect Fall Weather for First-Timers
deck: Monday, October 26 brings mild highs near 77°F with mostly sunny skies and light southeast winds — ideal conditions for your first Branson lake day or a relaxed Landing stroll. No heat dome, just comfortable Ozark autumn.
